user.title: Smart Heating Control
user.description: Create the house. Rooms are added afterwards with "Add room"; all other options are in the integration options.

data_description.temperature_unit: Every temperature of this house is entered and shown in this unit. It can be changed later with Reconfigure; the values are converted.
data_description.name: Shown on the devices and in the card.
data_description.persons: People whose location decides home / nearby / far. Leave empty only if presence should not matter: the house is then always 'home' and only the schedule decides.
data_description.nearby_zones: Zones where the house counts as 'nearby' (eco), e.g. your city. Outside home and every zone = 'far' (away). Leave empty if you only want home / far.
data_description.home_rule: 'At least one' suits most homes. 'Everybody' lowers the heating as soon as one person leaves.

reconfigure.title: Temperature unit
reconfigure.description: Every temperature of this house (settings, levels, card) is shown in this unit. The values are converted, nothing has to be entered again.

data_description.temperature_unit: Every temperature of this house is entered and shown in this unit. It can be changed later with Reconfigure; the values are converted.

heating.title: Heating of the whole house
heating.description: The thermostat (or relay) that heats the whole house. It becomes the zone {zone} and works with every option of the house. Rooms with their own valves can be added later with "Add room".

data_description.source: What heats the whole house: a Generic Thermostat or a relay that starts the boiler, or another thermostat. 'No heating devices yet' when nothing heats the whole house as one zone and every room is added with its own heating: TRVs or valves on the radiators, electric heaters, a heat pump or air conditioner, underfloor heating.

data_description.climates: The thermostat that controls the boiler, e.g. the Generic Thermostat entity (climate.climate).
data_description.switches: Only when a relay heats the house directly, without a thermostat.
data_description.command_mode: Only for thermostats other than Generic Thermostat. See the room settings for the difference.
data_description.trv_boost: While the room asks for heat, the TRVs get a higher temperature so they stay open until the room is warm; the rest of the time they get the target. The heat demand then comes from the room sensor, with the hysteresis. Needs a temperature sensor in the room. Only with the Temperature command.

heating_on_off.title: On / off control
heating_on_off.description: The integration switches the heating on and off around the target.

data_description.temperature_sensors: Sensors in the room, used instead of the thermostat sensor (more accurate when the thermostat sits next to a heat source). Leave empty to use the thermostat sensor; needed for relays, which have no sensor.
data_description.hysteresis: Heating starts below target minus this value and stops above target plus this value.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Minimum time on. 0 for heaters that do not mind short cycles.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Minimum time off between two starts.

heating_thermostat.title: Thermostat
heating_thermostat.description: The thermostat keeps the temperature; the integration only sends the level or the temperature.

data_description.learn_tolerance: How far below the target the thermostat lets the room fall before heating (its own tolerance). The heating rate is learned from rises that start at least this below the target.
data_description.hysteresis: This thermostat does not report when it heats (no hvac_action): it counts as heating from this far below its set temperature until this far above it, like a relay. Used for the heat demand, the boiler, the heating time, the learning and as the comfort of the optimal stop.

heating_boost.title: TRV boost
heating_boost.description: While the room asks for heat the TRVs get the boost temperature, the rest of the time the target. The room asks for heat from target minus the hysteresis until target plus the hysteresis, measured by the room sensor.

data_description.temperature_sensors: Sensors in the room: the heat demand is decided from them, not from the TRV sensor next to the radiator.
data_description.trv_boost_temperature: Sent to the TRVs while the room asks for heat, never below the target and never above the maximum temperature of the house or of the TRVs. Empty = the maximum temperature of the house.
data_description.hysteresis: The room asks for heat below target minus this value and stops above target plus this value, measured by the room sensor.

error.entity_is_gt_heater: {entity} is the relay of a Generic Thermostat used by {owner}. It cannot also be controlled here.
error.room_sensor_is_outdoor: {entity} is the outdoor sensor of {owner}. Choose a sensor in the room.

data_description.persons: People whose location decides home / nearby / far. Leave empty only if presence should not matter: the house is then always 'home' and only the schedule decides.
data_description.home_rule: 'At least one' suits most homes. 'Everybody' lowers the heating as soon as one person leaves.
data_description.nearby_zones: Zones where the house counts as 'nearby' (eco), e.g. your city. Outside home and every zone = 'far' (away). Leave empty if you only want home / far.
data_description.nearby_geometric: Uses the GPS coordinates: someone in a zone that lies inside a nearby zone (e.g. Office in the city) counts as nearby. Turn off if people have no GPS location.
data_description.departure_delay: How long everybody must be gone before the heating is lowered. Avoids reacting to short trips (shop, walking the dog).
data_description.arrival_delay: Usually 0: the heating returns as soon as someone is home. Raise it only if GPS sometimes reports 'home' by mistake.
data_description.presence_sensors: Keep the house 'home' while on (mmWave, motion, a switch for people without a phone). Leave empty if everybody has the companion app.
data_description.guest_expire_hours: Guest mode keeps the house 'home'; it turns off by itself after this many hours. 0 = only manually.
data_description.proximity_distance: Proximity integration distance sensor, for preheating on the way home. Leave empty without Proximity.
data_description.proximity_direction: Proximity direction sensor. Set it so that sitting at an office near home does not start the preheating.
data_description.travel_time: Travel time to home (Waze, Google Travel Time) for preheating. Leave empty if you do not have one.

data_description.workday_sensor: Workday integration sensor, so holidays use the profile of weekend days. Without it Mon–Fri are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Optional. An event titled with a profile name (e.g. home_office) or a level name (e.g. away) applies it while the event lasts. Leave empty if you do not plan days in a calendar.
data_description.day_boundary: Leave 00:00. Change it only for night shifts, so a night belongs to the previous day.

data.cutoff_enabled: Turn heating off when it is warm outside

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor temperature for the cutoff, season and compensation. If empty, the weather entity temperature is used.
data_description.weather: Used for the forecast, for the solar gain and as outdoor temperature when there is no sensor.
data_description.cutoff_enabled: Stops heating when the outdoor average reaches the cutoff temperature. Needs an outdoor sensor or a weather entity.
data_description.forecast_enabled: Uses the mean forecast of the next Forecast hours, never a single hour. Heating off by the outdoor average: it may run again when that mean is at or below cutoff minus hysteresis. Heating running: it is turned off earlier when that mean reaches the cutoff, and stays off until the mean falls to cutoff minus hysteresis. Needs a weather entity with an hourly forecast and the cutoff turned on.
data_description.season_mode: 'Always' if you switch the season with the Summer mode. 'Between dates' or 'Automatic' to stop heating outside the season by itself. 'Automatic' needs an outdoor sensor or a weather entity.
data_description.compensation_enabled: Raises the target a little when it is very cold outside (walls are colder). Needs an outdoor sensor or a weather entity. Leave off if the rooms keep the temperature well.
data_description.window_ignore_above: Open windows do not lower the heating when it is this warm outside. Needs an outdoor sensor or a weather entity. Leave empty to always react.

data_description.price_sensor: Energy price sensor (dynamic tariff). Leave empty with a fixed price.
data_description.pv_sensor: Power exported to the grid (W). Only useful with electric heating or a heat pump.

boiler.title: Heat source and heat demand

data.room_diff_alert: Alert when a room stays colder than

data_description.boiler_entity: The boiler (or the relay that starts the heat source) when the rooms cannot start it themselves (TRVs, zone valves). The integration starts it when rooms ask for heat, and the learning and the heating time count only while it runs. Leave empty with Generic Thermostat or a relay on the boiler, and never pick the relay Generic Thermostat already uses. With TRVs and a boiler started by a thermostat that is not in Home Assistant, the learning is not reliable: optimal start and stop are not recommended.
data_description.room_diff_alert: Alert when one room stays this much below its target while others are warm (stuck valve, open window). 0 = off; useful only with several rooms.

boiler.description:
Only for houses where the rooms cannot start the heat source themselves (TRVs or zone valves): the integration then starts it when rooms ask for heat, and a room heats (for the learning and the heating time) only while it runs. With Generic Thermostat or a relay on the boiler it stays empty; the alert below still works.

⚠️ With TRVs on every radiator, the installation must let the water through (an automatic bypass, a boiler with an internal bypass or one radiator without a TRV): the TRVs close at their target, and the heat source may run until its minimum on time ends.

boiler_alert.title: Heat source and heat demand
boiler_alert.description:
The heating of the whole house (Generic Thermostat or relay) already starts the boiler, so no heat source is chosen here. A heat source saved before is removed when this form is saved.

Rooms with TRVs added to such a house do not start the boiler: it runs only when the whole-house thermostat or relay asks for heat.

data.room_diff_alert: Alert when a room stays colder than

data_description.room_diff_alert: Alert when one room stays this much below its target while others are warm (stuck valve, open window). 0 = off; useful only with several rooms.

data.vacation_preheat_hours: Preheat before the end of a vacation
data.auto_vacation_hours: Automatic vacation after everyone is far for

data_description.override_mode: One rule for every manual change. 'Fixed duration' keeps it for the hours below. 'Until next reevaluation' ends when the schedule, presence, a window or the mode changes; the periodic check does not end it.
data_description.override_scope: 'Only that room' suits most homes. 'Whole house' copies a manual change to every room; use it only when every room has its own valves.
data_description.vacation_preheat_hours: The schedule returns this many hours before the vacation ends, so the house is warm when you arrive.
data_description.auto_vacation_hours: Turns on the vacation by itself after everybody has been far this long. 0 = only manually.
data_description.frost_temp: Used with an open window or the Off mode. Rooms with Generic Thermostat use its minimum temperature instead.
data_description.max_temp: No level, adjustment or manual change from the integration goes above this.
data_description.reevaluation_minutes: Safety check that resends the decision if a device lost it. Changes are applied immediately anyway; 5–15 minutes is fine.

data.alert_window_minutes: Alert when a window is open longer than
data.alert_unavailable_minutes: Alert when a device is unavailable longer than

data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for notifications in Home Assistant only.
data_description.alert_window_minutes: Alert when a window stays open this long while heating is needed.
data_description.alert_unavailable_minutes: Alert when a thermostat or sensor is unavailable this long.
data_description.battery_threshold: Alert when the battery of a room device (TRV, sensor) drops below this.
data_description.verify_commands: After 2 minutes checks that the device accepted the command, retries once, then alerts. Turn off only if a device reports its state slowly.

data_description.cutoff_hysteresis: Heating starts again only at or below cutoff minus this value, so it does not flip around the cutoff. The forecast mean uses the same limit.

data_description.season_end: Last day of the season: month and day, e.g. 04-15.

data_description.compensation_below: Outdoor temperature below which the compensation is added.

data_description.price_high: At or above this price the high-price adjustment is applied.
data_description.price_high_offset: Usually negative, e.g. -1° while energy is expensive.
data_description.price_low: At or below this price the low-price adjustment is applied.
data_description.price_low_offset: Usually positive, e.g. +1° while energy is cheap (electric heating, heat pump).
data_description.pv_threshold: Surplus from which the adjustment is applied.
data_description.pv_offset: Degrees added while there is surplus (e.g. +1).

data_description.reference_room: Only this room decides when it runs, the others just open or close their valves. Leave empty to use the number of rooms.

Off: the room has its own heat (electric heater, heat pump, air conditioner): it does not start the boiler, and it heats while its own device runs.

levels.title: Levels

data.nearby_mode: When nobody is home but someone is nearby

levels.description: The levels have fixed roles: home, sleep, eco (nearby), away (far / vacation), comfort and activity.

data_description.nearby_mode: Eco preset: uses the eco level. Fixed temperature: the temperature is chosen on the next page (with Generic Thermostat the preset becomes none).
data_description.nearby_not_above_schedule: Checked: when the schedule is lower than the nearby level or temperature, the lower one applies (being in town at night does not heat more than being home). Unchecked: the nearby level or temperature applies.
data_description.name_home: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_sleep: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_eco: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_away: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_comfort: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.name_activity: How this level is called in the schedule and in the card. Leave the default name if you do not need another one.
data_description.device_home: Preset of the thermostat used for this level (presets found: {presets}); the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).
data_description.device_sleep: Preset of the thermostat used for this level (presets found: {presets}); the thermostat keeps its temperature. Leave empty if the thermostat has no such preset: the temperature of the level below is sent instead (it is also shown when the thermostat does not report the preset temperature).

data_description.temperature_sensors: Sensors in the room, used instead of the thermostat sensor (more accurate when the thermostat sits next to a heat source). Leave empty to use the thermostat sensor; needed for relays, which have no sensor.
data_description.calibration_mode: Needs a room temperature sensor above. Offset: corrects the TRV sensor. External temperature: writes the room temperature into the TRV (if it supports it). Off otherwise.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: Motion / presence sensors of the room: when the room is empty for a while it goes to eco even if someone is home. Leave empty for rooms that should follow only the schedule.

data.window_drop_detect: Detect open windows from the temperature

data_description.window_sensors: Windows and doors of this room. Leave empty if there are none (the temperature drop detection below can help).
data_description.linked_window_sensors: Windows of other rooms that also cool this one, e.g. the living room balcony door for the hall.
data_description.window_drop_detect: Treats a quick temperature drop as an open window for 15 minutes. Useful for rooms without window sensors.

data_description.schedule_source: Internal schedule: written here or edited from the card. Schedule helper: a Home Assistant Schedule helper decides between two levels.
data_description.optimal_start: Starts heating early so the next level is reached on time. The heating speed is learned in a few days.
data_description.optimal_stop: Lowers the level before the next colder one, as early as the room can cool without falling out of the comfort of the current level. The cooling is learned from the periods without heat demand. Needs an outdoor temperature (sensor or weather) in the house settings; shown only then.

data_description.solar_offset: Negative value (e.g. -1) lowers the target while the sun shines, for rooms that get warm from the sun. Uses the weather entity of the house (shown only when one is set). 0 = off.
data_description.valve_exercise: Opens the TRVs fully 5 minutes once a week, against limescale, in every mode (also in summer). A pause, a manual change or an open window postpones it to later the same day; it does not ask for heat.

data_description.nearby_temp: Temperature sent while nobody is home and someone is nearby. Can be changed later from the card.

data_description.temperature_aggregation: With several sensors: average, the coldest or the median.
data_description.calibration_entities: The TRV number entities (offset or external temperature).
data_description.occupancy_minutes: How long the room must be empty before eco.
data_description.hysteresis: The room sensor decides the frost protection: below it the TRVs are boosted to open, until frost protection plus this value.

data_description.window_open_delay: How long a window must be open before the heating reacts. Short airing below this is ignored.
data_description.window_close_delay: How long to wait after closing before heating again.
data_description.window_action: Frost protection keeps a minimum temperature. Turn off stops the heating.
data_description.window_drop_degrees: Drop that counts as an open window.
data_description.window_drop_minutes: Time in which the drop must happen.

schedule_internal.title: Schedule
schedule_internal.description: One profile per line: `profile: HH:MM preset, HH:MM preset`. Which days each profile is for, and whether it is on, is set in the card (Schedule). Earlier profiles named workday, weekend or mon…sun keep their days. {error}

data_description.schedule: e.g. `workday: 00:00 sleep, 06:00 home, 22:00 sleep`. Easier to edit from the card.

data.helper_on_preset: Level while the helper is on
data.helper_off_preset: Level while the helper is off

data_description.schedule_helper: A Schedule helper of Home Assistant (Settings → Helpers).
data_description.helper_on_preset: Level while the helper is on.
data_description.helper_off_preset: Level while the helper is off.

data_description.optimal_stop_minutes: Never stops earlier than this. Until the cooling is learned, the lower level starts this early.
data_description.stop_tolerance: For thermostats that report hvac_action: how far below the current level the room may fall before the scheduled change (its comfort). 0 = the room must not fall below the level, so it stops early only when warmer than the level.

data_description.valve_exercise_time: Time of the valve exercise (best when nobody needs heat).
